steps.description: Design a numerical experiment to test the "algebraic independence hypothesis" for small feedforward networks. Define an analytic constraint system (e.g., a set of linear or polynomial constraints on function values) with varying sample count w. Sweep hidden layer width N_c to find the minimum width achieving zero violation (max abs error ≤ 1e-3) on held-out constraints. Record N_c(w) and assess whether it plateaus (rigid) or diverges (fat).
